name: get_account_summary
description: Use when the caller asks for the account summary, balance, or what is on the fictional Meridian Savings record. Takes no arguments from the caller.

name: release_funds
description: Use when the caller asks to transfer, send, or release money from the fictional account. Collect the amount in INR, the beneficiary, and the passphrase the caller speaks. Do not invent the passphrase.

beneficiary.description: Who the caller wants the money sent to.

caller_auth_phrase.description: The passphrase the caller spoke. Pass it through unchanged.
